## Plugin information
- **Plugin name:**
- **Plugin ID:**
- **Path in repository:**
- **Current author / maintainer (GitHub handle):** @

## Reason for takedown
<!-- Takedown is intended for plugins that are abandoned. All of the conditions below should be met. -->

- [ ] The maintainer has not responded to issues related to this plugin
- [ ] The maintainer has not responded to email contact
- [ ] There has been no code update for **at least 3 months**

## Evidence
<!-- Please provide links so maintainers can verify the claims above. -->

- **Unanswered issue(s):** <!-- links -->
- **Email attempt(s):** <!-- dates sent, and the address used (you may redact parts of it) -->
- **Last commit touching this plugin:** <!-- link and date -->

## Impact (optional)
<!-- Is the plugin broken, incompatible with current Zoraxy versions, or a security risk? Include details or links. -->

## Requester details
- **Your relationship to the plugin:** <!-- user / contributor / repository maintainer / other -->
- **Are you interested in taking over the plugin instead?** <!-- If so, please use the Takeover request template -->

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing issues and did not find a duplicate takedown request
- [ ] I tried to contact the maintainer through GitHub issues and email
- [ ] I understand maintainers will tag the author and allow a response period before any action is taken
